name: session-coach
description: Coaches you while you work with Claude: a live session score, a turn judge, expert analysis and a setup audit, ranked P1 to P4 with exact fixes.

profile.title: Your role and stack
profile.description: Who the setup audit and expert analysis advise. The first audit runs before any session history exists and judges your setup from this point of view.
profile.default: AI application and data engineer. Snowflake is the enterprise data warehouse (SQL, dbt, Snowpark, Cortex). Apps run in Azure containers (Container Apps, AKS, ACR) and Snowpark Container Services. Code lives in GitHub, with pull requests and GitHub Actions.

subreddits.title: Subreddits
subreddits.description: Comma-separated subreddits the coach reads through RSS.

xHandles.title: X accounts
xHandles.description: Comma-separated X handles, read only through the mirrors in xMirrors.

xMirrors.title: X mirrors
xMirrors.description: Comma-separated RSS URL templates for X, with {handle}, for example https://your-nitter.example/{handle}/rss.

extraFeeds.title: Expert feeds
extraFeeds.description: Comma-separated RSS or Atom feeds of expert blogs.

judgeTurns.title: Judge every turn
judgeTurns.description: Give a verdict after every turn.

openPane.title: Open the pane
openPane.description: auto opens the pane at session start. command opens it only from /coach or Details.

playbookUrl.title: Playbook link
playbookUrl.description: Where recommendations link for their station. Empty means the published line map.

analyzeEvery.title: Turns between analyses
analyzeEvery.description: Turns between expert analyses. 0 turns automatic analysis off.

playbookModel.title: Playbook model
playbookModel.description: The model that builds the playbook.

analysisModel.title: Analysis model
analysisModel.description: The model for expert analysis and the setup audit.

judgeModel.title: Judge model
judgeModel.description: The model for the turn judge.

obsidianDir.title: Obsidian folder
obsidianDir.description: A folder to write the session report to at the end of each session. Empty turns it off.
